verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version lifecycles, or a deprecation policy for Adyen's risk-related APIs. The cited items cover Disputes API, Referrals API, webhooks, an OpenAPI repo and an MCP server, but none addresses versioning or deprecation. A payments API platform could plausibly document this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
